source_instruction: i'm looking for a flats made of ethylene vinyl. choose the ones in tan color and size 9.5 narrow.
query: I stopped by the community garden on my walk over this morning, and the raised beds are absolutely bursting right now—someone planted a whole row of sunflowers that are already taller than I am, their big golden heads turned straight toward the bright mid-morning sun, and a handful of bumblebees were bumbling around so slow and fuzzy I could’ve leaned in to count the little pollen dust stripes on their backs if I’d wanted to. The old guy who tends the tomato plot next to the entrance handed me a warm, sun-ripened cherry tomato straight off the vine when I paused to look, and it was so sweet it tasted like summer concentrated into one tiny, juicy pop, no salt or seasoning needed at all. A group of little kids from the nearby rec center was clustered around the herb bed too, passing around crinkly mint leaves and sniffing them with these over-the-top dramatic faces, laughing so loud when one kid took a big bite of a leaf and made a silly sour expression that a couple of sparrows hopped off the garden fence to see what all the noise was about. I’m browsing the women’s sandals section right now, and I’ve heard pairs that use ethylene propylene as the key material, with a tan leather metallic synthetic upper in a size 9.5 narrow, are out there. I’ve also heard that options at a good price point, none way out of a typical affordable range for this style, are the ones that land in line with that exact set of specs first.
